observations: A large rounded head shape, outlined in thick black, fills most of the canvas against a background of overlapping diagonal stripes in red, green, yellow, and teal.

The right eye is a dense spiral of red and yellow lines inside a dark-red ring; the left eye area holds a loose orange scribble circle; a wide mouth shows a row of white tooth shapes edged in dark-red zigzag lines.

Across the yellow interior of the head, smaller marks compete for space: purple comb-like strokes, a blue spiral, a triangular yellow burst, and a pink outline loop that extends outside the head's left edge.
reading: The head shape holds its ground against a background that pushes back with equal force. Two mismatched eye forms — one tightly wound, one loosely scrawled — give the face an off-balance look that reads as agitation rather than calm. The wide tooth-lined mouth, framed in zigzag red, pulls the lower half open. Layered marks inside the head suggest crowding rather than order.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #221 and nnxyz nnotb #223. Both use a large central face form with dense interior marks, but #222 sits on a warmer yellow ground where #221 favors brown and #223 leans toward dark grey-blue.
